meta.purpose: Final re-verification post wave-18+19 fixes. Same 60 files, same 8 criteria. Criteria applied against IMPLEMENTED schema files (src/content/schemas/*), not stale SCHEMAS.md docs.

important_correction_vs_v1_v2.relic_schema_finding: Prior audits incorrectly flagged all 5 relic files as schema violations (missing 'era', 'drops', 'refinement', 'slug'). The ACTUAL implemented schema (src/content/schemas/relics.ts) uses 'era_letter' (not 'era'), 'drop_systems' (not 'drops'), 'refinement_costs' (not 'refinement'), and does NOT require 'slug'. All relic files match the implemented schema. These were false positives from comparing against stale SCHEMAS.md documentation.
important_correction_vs_v1_v2.arcane_slug_finding: Prior audits flagged arcane-impetus as missing 'slug'. The ACTUAL implemented schema (src/content/schemas/arcanes.ts) does NOT require 'slug'. This was also a false positive from SCHEMAS.md docs.
